IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১) Today is Wednesday. After 45 days, it will be:
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: Today is Wednesday. After 45 days, it will be:

Solution:
We know that each day of the week is repeated after 7 days.

45 ÷ 7 = 6 (remainder 3)

So, after (7 × 6) = 42 days it will be Wednesday.
∴ after 45 days it will be (Wednesday + 3 days) = Saturday

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ২) Which of the following is not a leap year?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: Which of the following is not a leap year?

Solution:
A leap year is divisible by 4.

Here, 
2008 ÷ 4 = 502, divisible by 4 , so leap year.
2012 ÷ 4 = 503, divisible by 4 , so leap year.
2020 ÷ 4 = 505, divisible by 4 , so leap year.
2022 ÷ 4 = 505, remainder 2, so not leap year.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৩) If cotθ = 5/12, then secθ = ?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: If cotθ = 5/12, then secθ = ?

Solution:
এখানে,
cotθ = 5/12 = ভূমি/লম্ব

∴ ভূমি = 5, লম্ব= 12
∴ অতিভুজ = √(52+ 122)
= √169 = 13

∴ secθ = অতিভুজ/ভূমি
= 13/5

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৪) An accurate clock shows 3:00 PM. Through how many degrees will the hour hand rotate when the clock shows 9:00 PM?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: An accurate clock shows 3:00 PM. Through how many degrees will the hour hand rotate when the clock shows 9:00 PM?

Solution:
From 3.00 pm to 9.00 pm,
total time = 9 - 3 = 6 hours

We know,
Angle traced by hour hand in 12 hours =  360°

∴ Angle traced by hour hand in 6 hours,
= (360 × 6)/12
= 180°

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৫) If the day before yesterday was Thursday, when will Sunday be?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: If the day before yesterday was Thursday, when will Sunday be?

Solution:
Day before yesterday was Thursday
⇒ Yesterday was a Friday
⇒ Today is a Saturday
⇒ Tomorrow is a Sunday

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ৮) A clock is started at noon. By 20 minutes past 4, through how many degrees has the hour hand turned?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: A clock is started at noon. By 20 minutes past 4, through how many degrees has the hour hand turned?

From noon (12.00 pm) to 4 pm = 4 hours
and 20 minutes = 20/60 hours = 1/3 hours

Total time = (4 + 1/3) = 13/3 hours

We know,
Angle traced by hour hand in 12 hours =  360°

∴ Angle in 13/3 hours,
= (360/12) × (13/3)
= 130°

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question:

IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: What will come at the place of question mark ?
9, 17, 33, 65, ?

Solution:
Here,
First term = 9
Second term = (9 × 2 -1) = 17
Third term = (17 × 2 -1) = 33
Fourth term = (33 × 2 -1) = 65
∴ Fifth term = (65 × 2 -1) = 129

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১০) It was Tuesday on January 1, 2008. What was the day of the week on Jan 1, 2009?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: It was Tuesday on January 1, 2008. What was the day of the week on Jan 1, 2009?

Solution: 
The year 2008 is a leap year. So, it has 2 odd days.
Given,1st day of the year 2008 is Tuesday 
So, 1st day of the year 2009 is 2 days beyond Tuesday.
Hence, it will be Thursday.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১২) Through what angle does the minute hand of a clock turn in 5 minutes ?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: Through what angle does the minute hand of a clock turn in 5 minutes ?

Solution:
We know,
Angle traced by Minutes hand in 60 min =  360°

∴ Angle of minutes hand in 5 min,
= (360 × 5)/60
= 30°

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৫) Anika is taller than Bristi but shorter than Kabir. Rafi is shorter than Bristi. Shawon is taller than Anika but shorter than Kabir. Who is the tallest among them?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: Anika is taller than Bristi but shorter than Kabir. Rafi is shorter than Bristi. Shawon is taller than Anika but shorter than Kabir. Who is the tallest among them?

Solution: 
From the first statement:
Kabir > Anika > Bristi

From the second statement:
Bristi > Rafi

From the third statement:
Kabir > Shawon > Anika

Putting everything together:
Kabir > Shawon > Anika > Bristi > Rafi

∴ Kabir is the tallest.

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৬) If tanθ =√3 and sinθ = √3/2. Find the value of cosθ.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: If tanθ =√3 and sinθ = √3/2. Find the value of cosθ.

Solution:
Given,
tanθ =√3 and sinθ = √3/2

We know,
tanθ = sinθ/cosθ
⇒√3 = (√3/2)/cosθ
⇒ cosθ = (√3/2)/√3
∴ cosθ = 1/2

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৭) A 50-meter cable is attached from the top of a vertical pole down to the ground. If the cable makes an angle of 30 degrees with the ground, find the height of the pole.
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: A 50-meter cable is attached from the top of a vertical pole down to the ground. If the cable makes an angle of 30 degrees with the ground, find the height of the pole.

Solution: 

ধরি,
উচ্চতা(Height), AB = h

দেয়া আছে,
AC = 50m                    
∠ACB = 30°

∴ sin30°= AB/AC
⇒ 1/2 = h/50
⇒ h = 50 × 1/2
∴ h = 25 m

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৮) At what angle the hands of a clock are inclined at 10 minutes past 4?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: At what angle the hands of a clock are inclined at 10 minutes past 4?

Solution:
Hours hand moves in 10 past 4 from 12 pm = (4 + 10/60) hour
= 4 + 1/6 
= 25/6 hour

We know,
Angle traced by hours hand in 12 hours =  360°

∴ Angle of hours hand in 25/6 hour,
= (360 × 25)/(12 ×6)
= 125°

Again,
Angle traced by Minutes hand in 60 min =  360°

∴ Angle of minutes hand in 10 min,
= (360 × 10)/60
= 60°

∴ Angle between hours and minutes hand  = (125° - 60°)
= 65°

IBA-Faculty-Prep.question: ১৯) Four boys are sitting on a bench to be photographed. Amin is to the left of Bilal. Rafi is to the right of Bilal. Tariq is between Bilal and Rafi. Who would be third from the left in the photograph?
IBA-Faculty-Prep.exp:
Question: Four boys are sitting on a bench to be photographed. Amin is to the left of Bilal. Rafi is to the right of Bilal. Tariq is between Bilal and Rafi. Who would be third from the left in the photograph?

solution:
Amin is to the left of Bilal
→ Amin — Bilal

Rafi is to the right of Bilal
→ Bilal — Rafi

Tariq is between Bilal and Rafi
→ Bilal — Tariq — Rafi

Now place all four:
Amin — Bilal — Tariq — Rafi

∴ Tariq would be third from the left in the photograph.
